name: Central Data Systems
summary: West Perth ISP and data centre operator (Central Data Systems Pty Ltd, founded 1983); built ISP/data centre infrastructure 1995; early IP block registered as SATIX (1997); AS18065; WAIX participant as 'Central Data' (2007); pivoted to cloud computing/IT consultancy.

events.details: Company founded 1983 as IT consultancy; built ISP/data centre infrastructure 1995; IP block 203.132.96.0-127 registered as SATIX (1997 APNIC); AS18065 (CENTRAL-AS-AP) registered to Central Data System Pty Ltd; 88 Havelock St, West Perth WA 6005.
ISP services wound down; company continues as cloud computing and IT consultancy (QV.1 data centre, GoPC.net cloud platform).
